The gang runs into a German college student named Beatrix, who slices through a zombie!

Akira and his friends run into a man named Kumano, who is constructing a treehouse in the forest.

Higurashi prepares to take his revenge on society, and sets his plan into action.
Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
Akira and his friends split up to save the villagers from the massive swarm of zombies.
Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: Voice

Mysterious series of murders show no signs of stopping. The guilt of putting Kazumi's life in danger further weighs down Jun, leading the two to revisit Kazumi's former home where her parents were murdered.
Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: Hunger
Fearing that she is slowly losing control of herself, Jun soon decides that she can no longer continue her career as a fashion model.
Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: Body
Jun is now kept in a HA facility. As they conduct various examinations she wonders off to a sector of the lab where she finds Dr. Bates who has been captured by Lan.
Kurei will go to sinister lengths to discover immortality's secrets.
Recca, Fuko, and Domon head into battle.

Can Recca survive the evil lair of Mokuren?

Recca partners with an unlikely ally.

Joseph uses his Stand to generate a spirit message from a TV, only to receive a warning claiming that Kakyoin is a traitor. Meanwhile, Jotaro, Ann and Kakyoin are out exploring Singapore when Kakyoin begins acting strangely.
The Joestars' group arrives in India, where Polnareff is attacked by a Stand only visible through a mirror. As terrifying as it is, the Stand could also be related to his sister's murder.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Emperor and the Hanged Man Part 2
When Avdol is struck down defending Polnareff, the Frenchman goes into a state of shock, leaving him vulnerable. That is when "Hanged Man," Centerfold's Stand, begins its most furious attack.
Jotaro and the others next head toward Varanasi. On their way there, Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen. At first, it doesn't bother him much, but the bigger it gets, the creepier it looks.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Wheel of Fortune
Jotaro and his group head toward Pakistan by car. Polnareff is behind the wheel on a dangerous mountain road when a mysterious vehicle starts impeding their progress.
After surviving another attack, Jotaro and his team make it to Pakistan, where they stop at an inn to rest. The village around the inn, however, is quiet, and its inhabitants rather odd.
Polnareff realizes that Enyaba is a new assassin sent by DIO. He is prevented from warning his comrades by Enyaba's Stand "Justice," which has the ability to control corpses.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Lovers Part 1
After surviving Enyaba's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi. There, they encounter DIO's next assassin, Dan of Steel.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Lovers Part 2

Dan of Steel's Stand, "The Lovers," has entered Joseph's brain. With Joseph's life on the line, Jotaro has no choice but to carry out Dan's orders, but the rest of his companions have their own say in the matter.
Jotaro and his fellows take camels and travel across the desert, headed for Cairo. Along the way, though, they can't shake the sensation that someone or something is watching their every move.

Kakyoin dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream he witnesses Death cut down a dog, but after waking up in terror he can't remember what the nightmare was about.
Kakyoin tries to convince the others that the baby is a Stand user, but they merely start to doubt his sanity. Unable to persuade his friends, Kakyoin resorts to some extreme measures.
Jotaro and the team visit an island in the Red Sea and find Avdol's father, renewing the grief Polnareff felt over his friend's death. But perhaps there is a way he can right that wrong. Or not.
Polnareff revives his sister Shelly using one of his three wishes but is then attacked by her. The enemy Stand user, Cameo, then says he'll grant Polnareff's last wish and revives Avdol.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 1
Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of transport, but as they travel through the Red Sea they realize that there are few places to escape to should danger arise underwater.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 2
The team attempts to escape the submarine with scuba gear as it sinks under attacks from the shape-changing enemy Stand "High Priestess."
Though he's been doing the hero gig for three years, Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him.
654ca7f92c1d3300086b608c: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
With his childhood bully back in town, Po must learn to face his fear or risk losing his Dragon Warrior mojo and those that are most important to him.
Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
Tired of Po getting all the credit and acclaim, the Furious Five quit the Jade Palace and strike out on their own.
Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

It's a battle between master and father when Shifu and Mr. Ping compete for Po's attention and affection during a camping trip. But will their competition get in the way of Po defeating the Valley's newest menace?
Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
After a blow to the head leaves Po with amnesia, Fung and the Croc Bandits are more than happy to use it to their advantage...by convincing the Dragon Warrior that he is their evil bandit leader.
All is well at Area Fifty-Something with Team Monster, until a lone alien imprisons the President and makes a permanent home on base.
The president's birthday is here! Dr. C has made him a gadget that will make him appear younger, but instead blasts him to infanthood!
Susan makes B.O.B. think that baths cure crankiness - B.O.B. leaps into action, chasing after Coverton to cure his crankiness once and for all!
B.O.B. is determined to have Coverton be his emergency buddy.  Instead, Coverton chooses to manipulate B.O.B. at a time when he needs him the most.
The Monsters find an alien in the woods doing an earth studies project, which has a lot of sensitive data that could be used for an invasion!
B.O.B. discovers a secret switch that General Monger tells him not to touch. Will it get rewired before the Big Blue Blob can get to flip it?
Dr. C is split into two through his new teleportation machine.  Can the Monsters reunite the wild and brainy roaches before it's too late?
Sqweep fashions a canine brainwave device to make B.O.B. the perfect pet.  It works great on everyone on the base but B.O.B.
Dr. C doubles his strength, but lessens his genius.  Can the other Monsters save him before it's too late?
When Dr. C invents a "living" smart-phone, Coverton diabolically plans to use the smart-phone to hack the base's mainframe.

It's April Fool's Day at Area Fifty-Something as Susan tries to prevent the Monsters from destroying the base with a prank! Dr. C's "Ph.D" is in jeopardy as a former teacher reveals a missing music grade in his transcript.
A new alien, Sta'abi, comes to Earth in search of a ferocious beast called Vornicarn.  Soon, everyone is on a chase in order to save the planet from Vornicarn's terror!
Susan is in a bind after spilling food on Sta'abi and apologizing about it.  Insulted, Sta'abi hunts Susan to feed her "fralnick" to Vornicarn.

Strange secrets begin to unfold when Derek returns to expose our friends at Area Fifty Something.  Monger is away for the weekend! This is great news for Team Monster and Team Alien until they're introduced to Rule-Bot.
Link and Sta'abi duel for driving privileges of a new supercar. Sqweep wants to drive too though, and takes off on a supersonic joyride.
With everyone down with alien flu, Coverton tries to steal base secrets, but fails to account for a huge gelatinous hallucinating B.O.B.  Vornicarn's bad behavior lands him in the Isolation Zone.
B.O.B. eats Dr. C's "probabilitator" and foresees Coverton with a crown, but soon Coverton discovers the painful truth about his future.

Sqweep has to go "number seven". Team Monster fears the destruction it will cause and sets out to contain it!  Link pursues Sta'abi using a pheromone spray of Sqweep's design that ends up having unforeseen consequences.

Susan and Bob play detective when Dr. Cutter arrives to update the base's technology.  Link and Bob find an old spaceship that they  take on a joyride, but things go bad when Coverton spots them and alarms the base of a hostile alien invasion.
After hacking into Monger's top secret files, the monsters learn that there was supposed to be another member of the team: The Man-Beast!

A stray kitten makes its way onto the base and accidently obtains Susan's ginormica powers! Sta'abi recruits Bob to teach her the "Art of Combat", after she witnesses him winning Link's new video game.
Monger gathers everyone for his favorite combat training exercise-a game of "no rules" dodge ball. Dr. Cockroach creates a special spray to give the President more authority.

The monsters start borrowing from Sqweep's allowance, but their spending spree soon comes to a halt when another alien planet arrives. After Dr. C messes with Sqweep's Earth Studies project, the little alien receives a Zrub--the lowest possible grade.
Dr. Cockroach's new teleportation experiment goes bad when he accidently teleports the Diner into space!
Susan has her ginormic hands full as she tries to escape the world wide web of an omniscient alien named... the Internet! Guest Star: Josh Gad

Beware of little leprechaun aliens - you don't want to know what can happen when the happy dancing and singing stop. Something horrifying lurks in Coverton's chambers, soTeam Monster is forced to submit to actual memory wipes.
After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship.   Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.
To better camouflage themselves as real Fire Nation citizens, the kids check out a Fire Nation school.  Avatar dance special.  Also, Zuko confronts Uncle.
When the gang comes to a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.
When Sokka feels he’s not contributing enough to the group, he seeks out a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.
Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation at Lo and Li’s beach house, where they learn a lot about themselves and each other.  Meanwhile, the kids face a new enemy.
Aang and Zuko are taken on parallel adventures that give them insight into their forefathers’ pasts – but how does the tale of Roku and Sozin matter to them now?
